name: A Midnight Stroll
source:
Doce, a tailor in Rio de Janeiro, is not having the best of nights, she got a few new wounds to add to her history. Now her girlfriend Casbah will try to get the pieces together.
Hey, nothing like a stroll in the middle of the night with your woman can't solve, right?

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/a-midnight-stroll]itch.io[/url]]
